_about: Lore data (docs/lore/README.md; decisions 257, 258): entries with facts, each fact saying who knows it. Code uses only status agreed. Facts, never lines to say.

entries.name: the land
entries.summary: Old stone places and the open ground around them, where monsters prowl.

facts.text: The land holds old stone places, rooms and corridors lit by lanterns and fires, and the open ground beyond them.
Monsters prowl the stone places and the open ground and attack whoever they see.
Fire burns whoever stands in it.
Whoever falls, townsfolk too, can be brought back, at the town's temple or at the healer's hut in the wilds.
Whether being brought back costs anything or marks the one brought back, and whether people speak of it.
People give directions as north, south, east and west.
How the land is governed and what its law is.
How real magic is, and what the gift is.
No one has been knighted in ages.
Whether there were ever knights in the land, and who made them.
Whether a named thing kept from the one it is named for, rather than given by them, is cursed, and who knows it.
Which gods are worshipped, and whether anyone besides the Blood Rot worships or fears the fallen star.
